sampling_rule: sort eligible question_id ascending; Python random.Random(seed).sample without replacement; preserve draw order
scope: all valid rows of gold_evidence_mapping_all_splits.jsonl; no official-split filter
eligibility: metadata only; exclude every banned ID; require at least five distinct nonempty passages in the fixed 365/40 corpus
reason: voluntary fresh sampling for the common BM25/Dense/Hybrid evaluation; no reuse of historical results; retirement does not imply contamination of every old question
usage_boundary: No tuning of models, parameters, algorithms, prompts or evidence rules using held-out questions, answers, evidence, labels or results. Add explicit new usage evidence before sampling.
